2018 Q1.gq: We remain confident in the outlook for our business and are reiterating our 2018 AFFO per share guidance of $3.14 to $3.20, which represents annual growth of about 3% to 5%.

2018 Q3.gq: We did reduce our guidance from $200 billion to $150 billion and that was largely being driven by timing and some opportunistic sales that we pulled from the market.

2021 Q4.bq: In 2021, our business generated $3.59 of AFFO per share, finishing near the high end of guidance and representing 5.9% annual growth.

2023 Q2.gq: Finally, from an earnings outlook perspective, the midpoint of our 2023 AFFO per share guidance is unchanged, though we are narrowing the guidance range of $3.96 to $4.01, representing approximately 1.8% growth at the midpoint.

2024 Q2.gq: As a reminder, we increased our guidance on June 4, which included the expectation of collecting the $16 million of lease termination fees that we recognized in the second quarter.

2026 Q2.gq: Turning to our 2026 outlook, as Sumit mentioned, we are increasing our full year AFFO per share guidance range to $4.44 to $4.45, also increasing our full year acquisitions guidance to $10 billion, up from $9.5 billion previously.
